speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient presents with knee pain that started yesterday and has been steadily worsening. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Patellofemoral Pain Syndrome (Chondromalacia Patellae)

The patient is a 23-year-old female with knee pain worsening over the last day, specifically linked to repetitive pivoting and twisting during volleyball. Given the history of recent activity increase and the mechanical nature of the injury, this presentation is highly suggestive of patellofemoral pain syndrome, though I will proceed with imaging to rule out meniscal tears or fractures.
